title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
summary: An interactive web project that renders the entire city of San Francisco as a navigable 3D video game-style map, allowing users to explore the city in a game-like environment. The project gained significant attention on Hacker News with 442 points and 140 comments.
problem_solved: Transforms static geographic map data into an engaging, interactive 3D video game experience for urban exploration.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative web development by gamifying city navigation and making geographic data visualization more accessible and entertaining.
